what: system.prmtop and system.inpcrd read by OpenMM with the settings of md/protocol.json; energy of the built coordinates (before any minimisation; hydrogens as tleap placed them)
note: the energy is not repeatable to the last digit with more than one thread; this file is not part of the built system

pairs_across_the_zinc.what: exceptions of OpenMM's NonbondedForce for the pairs whose bonds run through the zinc: one or two bonds apart, no interaction; three bonds apart, charge product / 1.2 and epsilon / 2.0; four bonds apart, no exception (full interaction)
